capture_mode: conservative address enrichment from already-saved official Savills RSS lot records
source_note: Audited all 53 saved official Savills RSS matches across the available 2016-2018 legacy history. Enriched 37 addressless legacy appearances only where auction ID, auction date, lot number, locality, property class and outcome agreed; price also had to agree wherever the legacy row retained a sale or available price. Sixteen already-addressed, price-conflicting, locality-conflicting or internally inconsistent mappings were rejected. Repeat appearances remain separate.

source_records.source_name: Saved official Savills London National RSS captures
source_records.evidence_excerpt: Each retained RSS item preserves the original Savills lot URL, archived RSS capture URL, auction date, lot number, address, property class, outcome and available result fields.
